title: Notepad
summary: Scratch notes the operator and the agent share: written from the pane or by a limb, stored as files.

surfaces.web: N/A(web parity is decided in WO-0002)

notes: M1 shim: both routes keep the exact 1.1.1 bodies (GET lists or reads by ?id=; POST actions delete|new|save over the same notepad functions). The three limbs already exist in the kernel's tool catalog (src/tools.py) — this manifest declares their ownership; it does not re-register them, so no tool changes behaviour and no tool is listed twice. The notepad pane moves into the module in Phase M2; the existing ids (#np-body etc.) stay. Writing is gated (p0) and every write goes through atomicio inside the module's own save/notepad/ tree.
